verdict.rationale: VPM provides a real street address (not a PO Box) with mail scanning and registered-agent service included free, which supports LLC registration and general business correspondence (docs-11, docs-27, docs-34). However, VPM's own documentation states that a virtual mailbox address alone is not sufficient for bank account opening/KYC, which requires the physical-presence-backed TruLease or TruResidence add-on products instead (virtualpostmail-docs-33), so the base address does not fully satisfy the story's bank KYC requirement without an upsell. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation the standard mailbox address is accepted for bank KYC without upgrading to TruLease/TruResidence, and no independent evidence of vendor-form acceptance.
